scope: One device and SDK version; one DSP worker/context; no physical capacity or useful-lane claim

clock_control.interpretation: The SDK reads CNTVCT but converts using the truncated coefficient 52.08333 ns/tick. Raw timestamp containment only established broad clock-domain compatibility, not exact phase alignment. Recover ticks with the verified coefficient before converting using 19.2 MHz; see timestamp-scale-evidence.json.

timestamp_correction.scope: Verified against the installed Android SDK binary and all 1301 metric packets from 15 captures. Recovered tick deltas match every raw systick_diff. Keep raw timestamps; apply this correction only to the verified decoder.

static_verification.arithmetic: uint64 ticks -> binary64 -> multiply by binary64 52.08333 -> truncate to uint64

summary.interpretation: Time-weighted SDK counter rates and SDK ratios; physical capacity uncalibrated

summary.integration_policy: Each selected SDK interval integrated once using its reported tick duration
summary.coverage_policy: Union of selected interval timestamps; overlaps never inflate coverage
summary.reference_clock_policy: Reported active integral divided by QDSP Clock integral; not physical HMX/HVX capacity
